projects.title: Glyphora
projects.summary: A multilingual community platform built around language ecosystems, with Chữ Nôm support, script-aware localization, social features, moderation, and production-readiness work across mobile and backend services.
projects.overview: Glyphora (万文社) is a multilingual community platform that treats languages and writing systems as part of the product structure rather than an add-on translation layer. The current Flutter application includes posts, discovery, profiles, friends and follows, real-time chat, shared rich-text notes, administration and moderation. Recent production-readiness work added account and blocking flows, moderation coverage, Android release signing, desktop branding, a full ARB/gen_l10n migration, a completed vi_Hani Chữ Nôm interface locale, and a midnight theme across the remaining Flutter screens. The backend combines Node.js, Express, Prisma and PostgreSQL with Firebase authentication, Firestore, Realtime Database and Storage services.

Friends, follows, profiles and real-time private chat
Shared rich-text notes inside conversation spaces
Language-learning categories with writing-system subcategories
Seven interface languages plus a dedicated vi_Hani Chữ Nôm script locale
Account security, blocking, reporting, moderation and administration
Midnight theme and production Android release-signing setup

projects.title: Commerce Platform
projects.summary: A full-stack commerce monorepo with a Flutter customer app, React administration dashboard, shared Node.js API, inventory workflows, PostgreSQL data, and Stripe payments.
projects.overview: Commerce Platform is the current monorepo for the former ShoppingApp project. It combines a Flutter customer application, a React and Vite administration dashboard, and a shared Node.js and Express REST API. The customer app covers authentication, products, categories, cart, checkout, addresses, orders, Stripe payments, localization and light/dark/system themes. The administration side adds protected authentication, product and category management, order workflows, inventory tracking and inventory movement history. Prisma connects the API to PostgreSQL, and the backend remains authoritative for final payment status.

projects.title: AI Code Tutor IDE
projects.summary: An Electron and Monaco learning IDE that combines real project editing, Dart semantic navigation, an animated AI tutor, persistent code notes, code-reading workflows, and collaborative learning features.
projects.overview: AI Code Tutor IDE is a TypeScript desktop editor built with Electron, Vite and Monaco. It opens and saves real project files, uses the Dart Analysis Server for semantic navigation, and places an animated tutor directly in the code view. The project has expanded beyond the original desktop prototype with project-level persistent code notes, image notes and appearance controls, dedicated reading and dictation surfaces, Android/GitHub workspace work, a public collaboration server, cross-device account login, persistent friend relationships and real-time shared dictation. The current repository therefore represents both a teaching-oriented IDE and an experimental collaborative code-reading environment.

projects.title: Kyrgyz Inflection Generator
projects.summary: A rule-based Python generator for Kyrgyz noun and verb inflection with vowel harmony, consonant behavior, tests, batch processing and structured dataset exports.
projects.overview: Kyrgyz Inflection Generator encodes Kyrgyz morphological rules as executable Python instead of manually storing every surface form. It generates noun plural, case and possessive forms as well as multiple verb person, tense and negative patterns. The grammar layer uses the last vowel, vowel harmony, final-consonant classes and special forms to choose suffixes and apply stem changes. Generated datasets can be exported through Pandas to CSV, JSON, Excel and SQLite for dictionaries, language-learning tools and NLP experiments.

Vowel harmony and consonant-sensitive suffix selection

projects.title: Multilanguage Dictionary
projects.summary: A Chinese-centric multilingual lexical database and dictionary architecture designed to scale across 100+ languages with language-specific schemas.
projects.overview: Multilanguage Dictionary uses Flask and SQLite to provide a Chinese-centric search system across many languages. Each language can have an independent SQLite database and a language-specific schema that describes parts of speech and fields instead of forcing every language into one universal entry model. Excel remains the editable source format, Python scripts convert source dictionaries into SQLite, and the HTML/CSS/JavaScript interface renders search results dynamically from the language schema. The long-term goal is a reusable multilingual lexical database rather than a collection of isolated dictionary pages.

projects.title: Multilingual Morphology Engine
projects.summary: A reusable rule-based morphology engine that separates phonological analysis, allomorph selection, language modules and human-readable rule tracing.
projects.overview: Multilingual Morphology Engine is designed as reusable linguistic infrastructure for dictionaries, language applications and NLP pipelines. The core separates phonological analysis, morphological rule selection, morphophonological exceptions, result generation and trace output. Version 0.1 focuses on Kyrgyz nominal morphology with plural and dative generation, vowel harmony, consonant assimilation and an explicit exception table. Language-specific behavior lives outside the core so additional languages can be added without turning the engine into a giant surface-form lookup table.

projects.title: nestless_flutter
projects.summary: A Flutter UI package that keeps common build methods shallow by combining semantic layout widgets with short wrapper-modifier chains while preserving normal Flutter runtime widgets.
projects.overview: nestless_flutter reduces wrapper-heavy Flutter source without replacing the Widget tree. Semantic layouts such as NColumn, NRow, NBox and NScrollColumn cover common compositions, while short modifiers such as nAlign, nPadAll, nWidth and nExpanded handle one-to-three simple wrappers. The package is intentionally designed to mix with standard Flutter widgets and keep DevTools output understandable rather than introducing a separate UI runtime.

projects.title: AI Code Tutor
projects.summary: A VS Code extension prototype where an animated AI programming tutor explains selected code, points at exact ranges, guides continuous voice walkthroughs, and accepts contextual interruptions.
projects.overview: AI Code Tutor is the editor-extension counterpart to the standalone IDE project. Its Tutor Core is intentionally editor-independent, while the first adapter targets VS Code. The extension reads the active editor context, sends source-backed requests to the OpenAI Responses API, consumes structured explanation steps with real line ranges, highlights and scrolls to the code being discussed, drives an animated tutor Webview and supports continuous TTS-guided explanations. V0.5 adds contextual questions that can interrupt the current lesson, preserve the current step and highlights, answer using nearby code and lesson context, and then resume the original walkthrough. API keys are stored with VS Code SecretStorage rather than source code or settings files.
